title: Polynomial-time pairing of two functions
statement: Let $f,g : \{0,1\}^* \to \{0,1\}^*$ be polynomial-time computable. The function that maps $x$ to the self-delimiting encoding of $(f(x),g(x))$ is polynomial-time computable.
replaced: Let $f$ and $g$ be polynomial-time computable functions on binary strings. Then the function sending $x$ to the self-delimiting encoding of the pair $(f(x), g(x))$ is polynomial-time computable.
